description: Kept both songs and set Thursday for the Princess.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Her eight shillings stayed where January had put them. She was not in the room.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Named on the line as the man who brought the figure. He was not in the room.
name: John Heminges

description: Stood to be measured and sent word that the sleeves must be long. He was not on your end of the call.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Named for Thursday. He was not in the room.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Heard the stop and went to look at the cuff.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Wrote the line and did not pay it.
name: William Shakespeare
